speaker: A
line: Who a company hires, and who walks out, says where it's heading. DOMINO turns those moves into two decisions: who to hire, and who to sell to. Search firms charge 20 to 33 percent of first-year pay to fill one role.
focus: Predicted opening card and its dated chips

speaker: B
line: Hiring first. Two ML platform engineers left Abacus.AI in October, and nobody has posted or hired for it since. Out of 1,410 job moves, fixed rules leave one provisional opening, until 30 November. An August move is struck: its month crosses the window edge.
focus: Funnel 1,410 > 312 > 250 > 95 > 3, then the departures table with the struck Aug row

line: Each run is its own process with a checkpoint after every step, so a killed run resumes without paying twice. One wrapper around every Crustdata call checks budget and cache, retries, and logs each try. The model only parses and drafts.
